milestone.name: P4 release assurance
milestone.objective: Produce trusted release evidence and establish whether version 1.1.2 can pass internal production gates.

lastCompletedWork.summary: Merged the validated workflow and audit hardening through protected PR #8, repaired cross-platform path handling and CodeQL file-state races, and validated a fresh-workspace demo launch that does not restore a premature localhost tab.

decisions.rationale: Source validation and merge do not satisfy trusted signing, independent review, artifact health, revocation, or production verification.

decisions.decision: Plan Live Chat Interaction as a reusable Project Orchestrator capability with a demo-first prototype.
decisions.rationale: The product should explain its capabilities, guide users through features, and answer follow-up questions without coupling the long-term capability to one countdown demo.

decisions.decision: Use a hybrid guided and model-backed design with voice and text.
decisions.rationale: Deterministic walkthroughs provide reliable onboarding while grounded freeform Q&A and optional speech support natural conversation.

decisions.decision: Require Azure Government discovery before selecting model or Speech services.
decisions.rationale: Service, model, region, quota, authorization, and data-boundary availability must be verified rather than assumed.

plannedInitiatives.name: Live Chat Interaction
plannedInitiatives.target: Reusable product capability, prototyped in C:\repos\skills-orchestrator-demo
plannedInitiatives.objective: Let a user ask what the application can do, receive a guided feature walkthrough, and continue asking grounded questions by text or voice.
firstVersion: A visible assistant entry point with text input, microphone control, transcript review, and optional spoken responses.
Deterministic capability cards and guided walkthroughs for reliable onboarding.
Freeform answers grounded only in approved product documentation and capability metadata, with source links and explicit unknowns.
Read-only behavior by default; any future action requires separate authorization and explicit user confirmation.
Graceful text-only and guided-only fallback when model or Speech services are unavailable.
architectureConstraints: Use AzureUSGovernment only for cloud model or Speech processing.
Run azure-discovery before selecting a region, model, Speech resource, quota, or deployment topology.
Keep credentials out of the browser; use a server-side boundary and managed identity for deployed Azure access.
Treat retrieved content and model output as untrusted; defend against prompt injection, unsupported claims, data leakage, and excessive agency.
Do not send microphone audio or transcripts to a cloud service until the user has clear notice and the applicable approval and privacy requirements are satisfied.
Do not create resources, incur cost, deploy, publish, commit, or push from this planning record.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can discover capabilities without knowing commands or feature names.
Users can complete at least one guided walkthrough and ask contextual follow-up questions.
Voice input exposes listening, transcript, correction, cancellation, permission-denied, and unavailable-service states.
Answers remain grounded, cite their product source, distinguish unknowns, and never claim an unavailable capability.
Keyboard-only, screen-reader, reduced-motion, responsive, and text-only experiences remain functional.
Security, privacy, latency, cost, failure-mode, and evaluation evidence pass before deployment approval is requested.
openDecisions: Which Azure Government model and Speech capabilities are currently available in the selected subscription and region?
What product documents form the authoritative grounding corpus and how are versions refreshed?
Should spoken responses default off, and what retention policy applies to transcripts?
What latency, answer-quality, accessibility, and cost thresholds define demo and production readiness?
Should the initial prototype remain informational or support separately confirmed product actions?

validation.evidence: PR #8 merged to default main commit 99b9ce6 after all 15 required checks passed; no PR-scoped CodeQL alerts remained.
A unique temporary workspace identity opened the recreated durable demo without restoring a stale localhost preview.
npm run check passed 134 of 135 tests with one expected platform-specific skip and verified all 45 skills.
Trusted signing, independent review, operational artifact evidence, revocation, and production verification remain incomplete.
Scope and constraints are recorded; no implementation, Azure discovery, resource creation, or deployment has occurred.

worktree.attribution: Current local changes are the approved fresh-workspace demo prompt fix, version 1.1.2 and dated repository documentation, contract coverage, deterministic generated reports, and synchronized continuity.

blockers: P4 production release assurance remains incomplete.
Trusted signing and a distinct qualified independent reviewer are not provisioned.
Restricted artifact distribution, installation-health signals, tested revocation, and production verification remain incomplete.
Live Chat Interaction lacks an approved implementation plan and current Azure Government service, model, quota, privacy, cost, and data-boundary evidence.
pendingApprovals: Any commit, push, pull request, merge, release, publication, deployment, Azure discovery, resource creation, or external mutation requires separate approval.
Live Chat implementation must not begin until its workflow plan is reviewed and approved.
Azure Government model or Speech provisioning and billable use require point-of-action approval after discovery and cost review.
limitations: Live Chat Interaction is a planning record, not an implementation commitment or cloud authorization.
No Azure Government model, Speech service, region, quota, endpoint, or data boundary has been selected or verified.
The current demo project is a local prototype workspace and is not part of this source repository.

nextAction.action: Create a reviewable, non-executing implementation plan for LIVE-CHAT-001 covering demo prototype, reusable product architecture, Azure Government discovery, threat model, grounding, voice and text UX, accessibility, evaluation, cost, rollout, rollback, and approval gates.
prerequisites: Use this handoff as the confirmed scope boundary.
Inspect the current demo and product architecture read-only.
Keep Azure discovery, resource creation, implementation, deployment, publication, commit, and push outside the planning action.
